description: This file defines the KeychainStore enum with static methods for loading, saving, and deleting string data in the keychain, acting as a wrapper around a generic keychain store implementation.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Loads a string value from the keychain for a given service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value to the keychain for a given service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a keychain entry for a given service and account.
